text:
Situation: Milrinone lactate (NDC 71288020011, labeler Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., manufactured at Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., FEI 3010625707) is in short supply at Corvale Lakeside with 8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 26 days on hand and Corvale East holds 15 days on hand with a different package size (NDC 71288020050).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for the Nanjing King-Friend plant show three VAI classifications: inspection 937313 ending 2015-05-12, inspection 1048084 ending 2018-04-03, and inspection 1224895 ending 2023-11-10. No OAI classification or other enforcement action appears in the supplied FDA records for this facility. The drug is not listed on FDA's drug shortage database as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: The shortage is local to Corvale Lakeside. System inventory exists to cover the gap. No FDA enforcement action links to the current supply gap. Verify Meitheal allocation status and check FDA's drug shortage database for any posted shortage reason.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 3 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Caplin Steriles Limited, NAI 2024-08-09). Approval: buyer.
4. Purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (Hikma Farmacêutica Portugal). Approval: buyer.
5. Purchase from Hospira, Inc. (Gland Pharma Limited, VAI 2024-07-25). Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
